# iximiuz-labs_play (Data Source)

Looks up a single iximiuz Labs play session by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "iximiuz-labs_play" "example" {
  id = "some-play-id"
}

output "play_status" {
  value = data.iximiuz-labs_play.example.status
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The unique ID of the play session.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) ISO timestamp of when the play was created.
- `expires_in` (Number) Seconds until the play expires.
- `page_url` (String) Web UI URL for the play.
- `status` (String) Current state of the play.
- `updated_at` (String) ISO timestamp of when the play was last updated.
